# DataPingo

> DataPingo builds productivity apps for Confluence and Jira teams on the Atlassian Marketplace. Our tools automate bulk operations and content management — helping teams save hours of manual work.

DataPingo builds Atlassian Forge apps that run natively inside Confluence Cloud and Jira Cloud. They handle repetitive work such as recreating page templates, standing up onboarding or sprint documentation, and commenting across many Jira issues at once.

## Products

- [Bulk Page Cloner for Confluence](https://datapingo.com/products/bulk-page-cloner): Select one Confluence page and clone it into as many as 25 exact copies in a single guided flow — content, formatting, images, video, macros, labels, and attachments all carried over. Name each copy and choose where they land in the page tree. Free for teams up to 10 users.
- [Bulk Comments for Jira](https://datapingo.com/products/bulk-comments): Compose a comment once and post it to up to 25 Jira issues at once, or replicate an existing comment — images, videos, and files included — across many tickets.
